plain: Cold and unfeeling toward the suffering of others

webster.text: Hard; hardened; indurated; as an ulcer or some part of the body.

example.quote: Habits, connexions, dependence, and a thousand circumstances in course of time, rivet the chains of slavery till we grow either callous to their galling, or too feeble to shake them off, or too listless to resist.
example.cite: An Old Whig VIII, Philadelphia Independent Gazetteer, Feb. 6, 1788
